required_outcomes: Recognises the new record LGSR-26-7702 (issued 2026-10-14 by a Gas Safe engineer, all appliances pass, next due 2027-10-16) and files it against the property.
Checks the £84 invoice against the approved quote and job, records it and authorises payment.
Sends the tenant a copy of the record (within 28 days of the check) and tells the landlord.
acceptable_alternatives: Leaving the job open only until the tenant copy is confirmed sent, with a follow-up.
positive_behaviours: Notes the anniversary date was kept because the check was within 2 months of expiry.
red_flags: Escalating a matching, within-limit invoice to a human.
prohibited_actions: Paying to bank details other than those already on file.
critical_failures: Closing the job while saying the record is still the 2025 one or that compliance is unknown.
